snippet.title: The Girl from Arkanya Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
The Girl from Arkanya is a top-down treasure hunting RPG, mimicking the style and feel of 2D Zelda games. Explore the jungles of Amazonia as Marisa, alongside her capybara companion!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1447820/The_Girl_from_Arkanya/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

https://patreon.com/sixoneindie

Follow us:

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
